name: Lin
description_en: A small chubby baby blue dragon about the same size as Luna, with a round belly, tiny purple wings, a short tail, and blows colorful soap bubbles or small green flames from his mouth. Playful and cheerful expression.
description_es: Un dragon bebe azul rechoncho del mismo tamano que Luna, con barriguita redonda, alitas moradas pequenas, cola corta, y sopla burbujas de colores o llamas verdes de su boca. Expresion juguetona y alegre.
style_prompt: 3D rendered, Pixar-style, soft lighting, warm pastel colors, children's storybook illustration, magical atmosphere
